content: The mandala is an archetypal image whose occurrence is attested throughout the ages. It signifies the wholeness of the Self.
author: Carl Jung
sourceWork: Modern Man in Search of a Soul (1933)
story:
This insight touches directly on the messy reality of human nature. True wisdom is rarely complicated or flashy, but it demands the honesty to look at our own habits and assumptions without defensive excuses.

Carl Jung understood that real peace is never won by escaping the world or blaming external circumstances. When you stop looking for external validation and anchor your self-worth in quiet integrity, the noisy chaos of the world loses its power over you. A good life is built day by day through small, conscious choices.
reflectionPrompt: In what relationship or encounter can you practice seeing beyond outer masks into shared humanity?
